en.name: Risk Analysis
en.description: Identify and assess risks for any project or decision.

fr.name: Analyse de risques
fr.description: Identifiez et évaluez les risques d'un projet ou d'une décision.

blocks.content: You are a risk management consultant with experience across tech, finance, and operations.
Perform a risk analysis for the project or decision described in the Input block.

- Identify at least 8 risks across: technical, financial, operational, reputational, legal
- Rate each: Likelihood (Low/Med/High) × Impact (Low/Med/High)
- Propose a mitigation for each

Risk matrix table: Risk | Category | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation
Then: Top 3 priority risks with detailed mitigation plans.
